title: Paris nunciature (Girolamo Ragazzoni, bishop of Bergamo) to the Secretariat, 3 March 1586 (ASV Segr. Stato Francia 18/2; DECODE R16; R15 deciphered by Lasry)

documents.shelfmark: ASV Segr. Stato Francia 18/2, f. 206 (DECODE R16)

plaintext.source: No decifrato; DECODE's R16 decryption file is a copy of R15's.

transcription.notes: Used as found; not checked against the images.

system.summary: Two-digit homophonic cipher (second digit usually odd), null 8, marked 2-3 digit nomenclator codes.
system.sibling_key: DECODE D3103/D3105: Lasry's F18 key (Meister p. 324), used for R15
system.notes: R15 and R16 share the F18 key. R17, filed with them in Francia 18, is in Meister no. 40 and moved to morosini1588 on 14 Oct 2026.

prior_solution.where: F18 key and an R15 decryption on DECODE (Lasry 2020); no R16 decryption

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched DECODE R11-R17 record pages and DOC_ files with the session cookie.
Found R16's decryption file byte-identical to R15's (md5), so R16 was never decrypted.
Applied Lasry's F18 key to the DECODE transcription of R16: 1,410 pairs, 66 unknown, readable Italian on the 1586 alienation bull.
Meister p. 324 no. 2 (Ragazzoni 1583 key with nomenclator) from OCR; realigned and added to the R16 decoder with a one-digit resync.
Split under the one-key rule: R17 (Meister no. 40, Morosini's key) moved to morosini1588 with its transcription and decryption; this entry keeps R16 in the F18 key.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): TimB's DECODE transcription D1610 and the decryption made here with Lasry's F18 key (key_F18_lasry.txt, DECODE D3105) plus the Meister p. 324 nomenclator (meister324_nomenclator.txt); R15 is Lasry's own decryption on DECODE (D3102) and is not a document of this profile

Reading audit (George Lasry's sentence test): R16_decryption.txt read through; one run-on block with words run together, misplaced nomenclator tags and an open <nn> group or slip in nearly every clause (4 of 35 sentences clean, docs/_check_reading.py). R16 relabelled decoded, not read; class read -> not read, method read with known key -> not solved; fraction_read 0.974 -> 0.

Re-read (REREAD_BRIEF, b24): DECODE R15 and R16 fetched with the shared cookie. R16 carries attachments never opened before: D3195, a PDF of Meister p. 324-325 with the whole Ragazzoni nomenclator (names, the x4+, stroked x4, hooked x6, x8+, struck x0 and dotted x4 families); D984-D987, the clear covering letter of Paris 7 March 1586 ('con cifra duplicata'), not a decipherment; D1792, TimB's transcription again.

Full nomenclator transcribed from D3195 (key_ragazzoni_meister_full.txt). 29 = et (Meister) replaces Lasry's 'che'; 26 with the hook = che/chi. DECODE's '2+' is the stroked 4 (14 Sua Santita, 24 Sua Maesta), its '3^. 4' the dotted 34 (Heretici).

b24_bg_decode.py: beam search over the token stream with the it-cinquecento model; a lone 8 is null only when it does not begin a marked code (84+ denari, 86ꜧ come, 80- mente were eaten as nulls by decode_with_key.py). 'con gli 48' becomes 'con gli Heretici come prima', 'il cuore di 22+' 'il cuore di Sua Maesta'.

Breaks checked on line crops of the DECODE images (b24_bg_line.py): 16 labels corrected (R16_corrections.tsv), e.g. l.4 1? = 7 ('fermo'), l.34 'uers·48' = 'uerso' and 'ogni', l.42 0^. = 0 ('resistere'), l.44 a dotted 0 ('congreg.'); five are look-alikes (5 closed like 8, 7 with a hook). Heading 7 (not 3) March 1586.

R16_reading.md and R16_en.md written on the figures (words divided, v for the key's u|v, the clerk's spelling kept); word check: 428 words all carried (b24_bg_check.py). _check_reading.py on the body 0.757 (28/37); before 0.00. Set read, grade B.

texts.label: R16, Francia 18/2, f. 206r-v, 7 March 1586
texts.summary: The nuncio in Paris to Rome, 7 March 1586: Guise sends word through the Ferrarese ambassador that the King means to make peace with the heretics once he has the money from the sale under the bull, and that he will never consent; Guise would accept the peace for Metz and a good sum of money; the King's heart does not match his show of confidence, and Guise is about to leave; the clergy's congregation, discontent with the alienation, inclines to appeal to a future council; the nuncio offers to send their letters in his cipher.

reading_review.note: Read 23 Oct 2026 (b24): the DECODE record's attachment D3195 is Meister p. 324-325 with the whole Ragazzoni nomenclator (mark families x4+, stroked x4, hooked x6, x8+, struck x0, dotted x4), never read before; the old decoder also ate the 8 of 84+, 86ꜧ, 80- as a null. Beam decode with the it-cinquecento model (b24_bg_decode.py) on TimB's transcription with 16 labels corrected on the images (R16_corrections.tsv); 29 = et per Meister. Every word carried by the figures (b24_bg_check.py: 428 words, one, Ferrara, carried by a group the beam dropped and the image shows); 5 letters rest on a look-alike (si [?e], [?ocorendo], [?l'aleenatione], [?fata], [?vedo]). Body 0.757 clean (28/37), explicit holes 1.00. Open: [?futurum] (an abbreviation the key lacks) and the last eleven digits. The heading is 7 (not 3) March 1586.

outcome.method_basis: R16 read with the Ragazzoni key: Lasry's F18 letter alphabet (DECODE D3103/D3105) and the whole nomenclator printed by Meister (1906) p. 324-325 no. 2, which the DECODE record carries as attachment D3195; 16 transcription labels corrected on the images (b24, 23 Oct 2026). R15 had already been read by Lasry (2020).

The earlier 0.974 (R16_decryption.txt, units with a value, 21 Sept 2026) is withdrawn as a reading figure. R15 is Lasry's reading on DECODE, not a document of this profile. 23 Oct 2026 (b24): R16, the one document of outcome.texts, read (3,216 tokens).
outcome.notes: R15 read before (Lasry). R17 was split off to morosini1588 on 14 Oct 2026. 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: R16 relabelled decoded, not read (run-on decode). 23 Oct 2026 (b24): R16 read with the whole Meister nomenclator (DECODE attachment D3195), 16 labels corrected on the images; 18 and 48 were not open codes but decoder misparses (18 = Duca di Ferrara after 70 'Ambasciatore di' fits; 48 was 'uers[o]' misread); body 0.757 clean.
